subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — usage-based pricing & credit request
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie@arklytics.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: initial ask

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking a look at this. We're evaluating Redwood's observability add-ons (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards) alongside our core Dedicated plan. Two quick asks: 1) can you share the pricing model for retention (monthly GB-month buckets), tracing (ingest / spans or sampled traces), and dashboards (seats + storage)? 2) We expect to ramp storage quickly in Q3 — would Redwood consider usage-based credits or a ramping discount for the first 6 months?

Attached I can share a high-level forecast; happy to sync over a short call.

Sophie Green
Head of Platform & Ops
Arklytics

Attachment: Arklytics_usage_forecast.csv (CSV, 45KB)
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Green <sophie@arklytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: initial ask

Hi Sophie,

Appreciate the forecast — that helps a lot. Quick answers up front:
- Retention: we price by GB-month with tiered buckets (30 / 90 / 365 days).
- Tracing: charged on ingest (GB) and sampled trace storage; we offer adjustable sampling and head-based trimming to control costs.
- Dashboards: per-seat pricing plus an aggregation/storage component for heavy queries.

We do have two common commercial levers for customers who are ramping: usage credits (applied against add-on bills) and short-term ramp discounts tied to a multi-month commit. We typically mix a one-time onboarding credit + a ramp tier that scales down over the first 3–6 months.

Before I put concrete numbers together, can you confirm: 1) whether Arklytics prefers a usage-credit approach (no upfront commitment) or a short-term minimum commit (3–12 months), and 2) the target retention mix (percent to 30/90/365) — your CSV hints at a lot of 90/365.

If it's easier, I can have Marissa prepare a short pricing options matrix for you. Does Monday next week work for a 30-minute call?

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Green <sophie@arklytics.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@arklytics.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: initial ask

Thanks Irene — Monday works. Quick clarifications inline: 
- Preference: we'd prefer a usage-credit model to avoid being locked into a high commit given uncertain ramp.
- Retention mix (est): 50% 90-day, 35% 365-day, 15% 30-day (spiky analytics queries need longer retention).

Separately, procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a 20% discount on published add-on rates for the first 6 months in exchange for a signed MSA and a 6–12 month visibility commitment (not a hard spend commitment, but an escalation path to convert to a commit if usage reaches defined thresholds). If not a straight percentage, they suggested equivalent usage credit that achieves ~20% effective discount.

Looking forward to Monday.

—Sophie

Subject: Observability add-ons — pricing options (attached)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the call today. Per our discussion, I've attached a compact options matrix (Observability_Addons_Pricing_v1.xlsx) that lays out three flavors:

Option A — Usage credits (no commit)
- Retention: $0.18 / GB-month (30d), $0.12 / GB-month (90d), $0.06 / GB-month (365d)
- Tracing: $250 / million spans ingested (with adjustable sampling)
- Dashboards: $125 / seat / month + $0.03 / GB query storage
- Commercial: 10% onboarding credit to be applied month-1; volume tiers auto-apply discounts at 2.5M GB-months

Option B — Short ramp commit (recommended for predictable economics)
- 6-month visibility letter + signed SOW (no financial lock until month-3), effective pricing: 15% off published add-on rates for months 1–6
- Includes $15k onboarding credit and a technical kickoff w/ two dedicated sessions

Option C — 12-month commit (most savings)
- 12-month minimum spend commitment on add-ons: 25% off published add-on rates; quarterly usage review; automatic rollback protection if month-to-month average exceeds forecast by >40%

We included an example for Arklytics' forecast showing 15% effective savings under Option B vs Option A given your retention mix. The spreadsheet also contains a suggested contract clause to allow a Q4 price revisit if Arklytics' aggregate add-on spend increases >35%.

Attachments: Observability_Addons_Pricing_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Next steps we discussed on the call:
- Sophie: check with procurement if Option B (15% + $15k credit) is acceptable as an alternative to 20% straight discount.
- Redwood: if approved, we'll prepare a short SOW and DocuSign for signatures; tech kickoff to follow within 7 business days of signature.

Happy to jump on another call to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Deals | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 03 June 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pricing options (internal note + proposal)

Looping in quick internal pricing rationale for the thread. Option B is our preferred commercial compromise for mid-stage PLG customers with unknown ramp: 15% + $15k credit preserves price protection for Redwood while giving Arklytics headroom to ramp. A few additional concessions we can offer if procurement needs them:
- One-time flexible credit schedule (split over first three invoices) to smooth effective discount, or
- A clause to convert to a 12-month commitment at any point with retroactive credit applied to reach the higher discount tier if both parties agree.

If Sophie confirms accept, I'll draft the SOW language and include the convert-to-commit clause.

—Aditya
